en: Check for updates: a button in About opens the website and tells you whether a newer version is out. The app still has no internet permission.
New look, matching the website, with a dark theme that follows your phone.
Each reading shows where it sits against its target on a range bar.
id: Cek update: tombol di About membuka website dan memberi tahu apakah ada versi yang lebih baru. Aplikasinya tetap tidak punya izin internet.
Tampilan baru, sama dengan websitenya, plus tema gelap yang ikut pengaturan HP.
Setiap angka punya bar rentang, jadi kelihatan posisinya terhadap target.
